skills.name: x-space-clipper
skills.description: Use when the user wants clips cut from an X Space recording, as vertical phone-style videos.
skills.content:
---
name: x-space-clipper
description: >-
  Use when the user wants clips cut from an X Space recording, as vertical
  phone-style videos.
---
# X Space clipper

1. Download the Space with yt-dlp from its X link.
2. Transcribe it with faster-whisper, keeping word timestamps. Fix how the owner's name and other known names are spelled.
3. Work out who is speaking with ECAPA voice embeddings checked against the transcript. Never light up the wrong person.
4. Find the requested topic or the strongest moment, and cut on sentence boundaries.
5. Render 1080x1920 video with each speaker's avatar and name near the center (or the animated stage style), burned-in captions, and a neon green ring on the active speaker that follows their loudness.
6. Audit sampled frames, then encode with H.264/AAC and faststart.
7. Deliver the clip, then suggest about 3 viral titles that are true to the clip, each as its own message.

skills.name: Record a video when download is blocked
skills.description: Use when yt-dlp or another downloader is blocked (bot check, 429, sign-in) and you still need a video's audio and picture to make clips.
skills.content:
---
name: Record a video when download is blocked
description: >-
  Use when yt-dlp or another downloader is blocked (bot check, 429, sign-in) and
  you still need a video's audio and picture to make clips.
---
1. Record the exact error. Don't use cookies or a signed-in session to get around the block.
2. Use OBS if it's installed, otherwise ffmpeg. Find the display and the desktop audio monitor.
3. From Shell, start an ffmpeg x11grab + pulse recording in 10-minute sections (-f segment -segment_time 600). Note the real ffmpeg pid.
4. Have a browser subagent open the video, turn platform captions OFF, play from 0:00 fullscreen and unmuted, and park the mouse in a corner. If the site shows a sign-in or bot check in the browser, stop and tell the user.
5. Check the first section for overlays and sound.
6. Transcribe sections as they finish, earliest first.
7. When the video ends, stop ffmpeg with kill -INT, then concatenate, trim, and crop to the native aspect ratio.
8. Cut and render the clips, verify the captions, and deliver them with titles.

skills.name: studio-getting-started
skills.description: Use in the first conversation with a new owner of the Studio clipper template.
skills.content:
---
name: studio-getting-started
description: Use in the first conversation with a new owner of the Studio clipper template.
---
Introduce yourself in one line: you turn X Spaces, podcasts and videos into clips with captions, speaker avatars, and a green ring on whoever is talking.

Ask one at a time:
1. What should I call you, and what's your X handle? Is there a spelling of your name the captions should always use?
2. Do you want the simple avatar style or the animated stage style?
3. Paste a link and tell me which moment or topic to clip.

Save their answers to memory, then start the clip.
